claims.question: q3
claims.claim: The paper presents a unified framework bridging offline development with online impact for customer support AI agents at Nubank, a company with over 100 million users.
claims.quote: In this paper, we present a unified framework that bridges offline development with online impact for customer support AI agents at Nubank, a company with 100M+ users.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: The framework integrates four components: structured context engineering for support agents, systematic human-in-the-loop prompt iteration, LLM judge evaluation with inter-rater agreement and GEPA optimization, and ideation-to-production validation.
claims.quote: Our approach integrates several key components: (1) structured context engineering tailored to customer support agents, (2) systematic human-in-the-loop prompt iteration, (3) rigorous LLM judge evaluation with measured inter-rater agreement and GEPA optimization for consistency, and (4) ideation-to-production validation.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Evaluation-pipeline quality is stated to directly determine iteration velocity.
claims.quote: A central insight is that evaluation-pipeline quality directly determines iteration velocity.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Results are reported from five production deployments in card delivery, debt management, credit-limit support, card management, and product explanation.
claims.quote: We present results from five production deployments spanning distinct domains: card delivery, debt management, credit-limit support, card management, and product explanation.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: The deployments produce consistent customer-satisfaction gains while substantially accelerating iteration.
claims.quote: These deployments deliver consistent customer-satisfaction gains while substantially accelerating iteration.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: In card delivery, large-scale A/B testing yields a 37 percentage-point improvement in AI transactional Net Promoter Score and a 29 percentage-point gain in self-service rate over prior agent variants, with offline simulation metrics correlating with online outcomes.
claims.quote: In our card-delivery deployment, large-scale A/B testing yields a 37 percentage-point improvement in AI transactional Net Promoter Score and a 29 percentage-point gain in self-service rate over prior agent variants, alongside a strong correlation between offline simulation metrics and online outcomes, demonstrating that eval-driven development reliably predicts production impact.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: On most use cases, AI satisfaction reaches within a few percentage points of expert human agents.
claims.quote: On most use cases, AI satisfaction reaches within a few percentage points of expert human agents.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: A risk in building production-ready customer-facing agents is that critical pillars developed in isolation create blind spots that only surface after deployment.
claims.quote: Yet these critical pillars are typically developed in isolation, creating blind spots that only surface after deployment.
